01  ·  The model
Efficiency does not come from making each asset faster.
It comes from making components once and recombining them.
One illustrative example runs through this deck: a seasonal skincare launch film, briefed once. It is an example chosen to explain the mechanism, not a description of your brief.

04  ·  Modularity
A brief uses the modules it needs.
Not every brief uses every module.
MAKE is a set of modules, not one product you switch on whole. The same platform serves a single-asset request and a nine-market campaign, with nothing to re-implement in between.
MAKE  ·  the module set
The platform
Each module serves a different part of the production funnel. A module is switched on for a brief or it is not. There is no partial state, no separate implementation, and no second platform underneath. Four of the eight are named below. The rest are named in our existing deck and are carried here as placeholders.
